stock.description: Huanxi Media Group Limited functions as an investment holding company, primarily focusing on media and entertainment ventures and associated services across mainland China and Hong Kong. Its activities encompass the production and financial backing of cinematic features and television drama series. Additionally, the company manages and expands huanxi.com, its proprietary online video platform, through which it provides diverse internet audio-visual programming. Founded in 1994, the enterprise was formerly known as 21 Holdings Limited before rebranding to Huanxi Media Group Limited in October 2015, and its headquarters are located in Admiralty, Hong Kong.
